WITH RECURSIVE chain (id, parent_id, depth) AS ( SELECT id, parent_id, 0 FROM iam_menu_item WHERE id = #{id} UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.parent_id, c.depth + 1 FROM iam_menu_item m JOIN chain c ON m.id = c.parent_id WHERE c.depth < 1000) SELECT id FROM chain ORDER BY depth
